prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Lousy service today. Flight #1710
Delta: Hey Patti, so sorry to hear this. Please feel free to voice any comments or concerns you may have via the link provided. https://t.co/fPLXqv8KGq *AJY

Customer: thank you for the phenomenal customer service today and everyday! ❤️ ya Delta! I will NEVER stray!
Delta: We are so happy to hear of your terrific experience. Thank you! 😄 ✈ *TMS

Customer: terrible service today
Delta: Hello Bryan. I do apologize for the service. Is there anything I can do to help? *TMS

Customer: Thanks to  for great customer service today! Getting me on standby for an earlier flight! #deltarocks
Delta: You're very welcome Shannon!  *HRS

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: praise):
"""Tanya G at LGA went above and beyond in customer service today. Thanks Tanya!"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Thank you for sharing, we’ll be sure to pass your kind words to Tanya! We’re thrilled she could make your day. ✈️😊
